title: AI in Email Marketing: A Complete Guide (2024) | Salesforce EU

facts.fact: Salesforce's own research reports that the number of outbound marketing emails increased 15% in the year before the article was written.
facts.quote: the number of outbound emails increased 15% last year.

facts.fact: Salesforce defines AI in email marketing as the use of machine learning algorithms to personalise content, optimise send times and segment audiences.
facts.quote: AI in email marketing uses machine learning algorithms to personalise content, optimise send times and segment audiences.
